verdict.rationale: Appwrite ships an official MCP server that lets LLMs interact directly with its API. Its docs say clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Claude Desktop can use it to operate on an Appwrite project. Agent skills and Markdown docs help those agents make accurate calls. However, natural-language operation works only through a third-party AI client, and nothing shows a built-in natural-language interface in the Console or CLI. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the product, documentation of which operations the MCP server covers, and independent hands-on confirmation that natural-language operation works.
